subject: SOW sequencing & fee allocation for Sera Health - sequencing request
messages:
From: Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@serahealth.com
Date: 2027-06-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request

Hi Dylan / Laura,

Quick note from our side — due to a regulatory pilot shift, we need to move Phase 2 (on-prem connector work) earlier in the program and push Phase 3 (UX refinement) to the back of the queue. That change affects implementation sequencing and the fee schedule in Exhibit B.

Can Redwood: 1) outline the operational impact to the delivery timeline; 2) provide suggested adjustments to fees/credits if we are moving effort between phases; and 3) confirm whether you prefer a change order or a short addendum to the SOW for signature?

We need this decision by end of next week to hit our internal gating. Copying procurement and Karen (legal) for visibility.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Cho
Director, Product Ops | Sera Health

(Attachment: initial_request_summary.xlsx)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request

Emma — thanks for the heads up. We can support re-sequencing; biggest impact is on implementation resource allocation and the milestone billing cadence. High-level options:

- Option A: Formal change order to reorder exhibits and keep total committed spend unchanged, with a pro-rated reallocation of fees between phases.
- Option B: Short addendum that specifies sequence changes + a one-time performance credit if Phase 2 ramp exceeds a 2-week acceleration window.

I've put a quick strawman in the attached proposed_addendum_outline.pdf that shows where we'd insert a gating clause and suggested credit language. Karthik — can you weigh in on pricing elasticity here? Laura / Legal: we will need a lightweight redline of the SOW and a place to capture accept/decline gates.

I can draft language for either path, but need confirmation on the preferred commercial approach.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: proposed_addendum_outline.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request — pricing options

Couple of pragmatic recommendations from pricing:

- Keep the committed GPU/throughput buckets unchanged for the term (avoid re-contracting commit volumes).
- Reallocate invoice milestones so that Phase 2 draws more implementation hours earlier; in our model that looks like a 15% reallocation from Phase 3 to Phase 2 for the first 90 days.
- Offer a one-time implementation acceleration credit equal to one week of implementation fees (~$9,500) if Sera validates go/no-go criteria at the earlier gate.

I've attached a simple worksheet with the rebalanced fee column (fee-rebalance-options.xlsx). If procurement needs a different spread, we can re-run quickly.

Karthik
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: fee-rebalance-options.xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request — legal redlines needed

Team / Emma,

Reviewed the strawman. A few legal items before we route for signature:

1) Acceptance criteria: we need objective gating language for the Phase 2 early move (logs showing connector throughput X, UAT test plan Y) — please confirm the exact acceptance tests.
2) Liability / service credits: if we provide an acceleration credit, confirm whether this is a credit against invoice or a refund — default to credit on the next invoice.
3) Signature authority: Sera's procurement page lists Karen Liu as primary signatory; if she signs we can treat procurement acceptance as binding.
4) Change order scope: prefer an addendum to the SOW that references MSA section 4.3 and includes a revocation clause if regulatory constraints force a rollback.

I attached a marked-up SOW (SeraHealth_SOW_v2_redline.pdf) with inline edits. For speed: if Emma can confirm acceptance tests and the credit mechanics by tomorrow, we can produce a final addendum for electronic signature.

Thanks — Monica
Legal Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SeraHealth_SOW_v2_redline.pdf)

From: Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@serahealth.com, Karen Liu <karen.liu@serahealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-11T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request — acceptance tests confirmed

Monica — thanks for the quick review. Acceptance tests for Phase 2 early cut:

- Connector throughput: sustained 1,000 req/min for 30 minutes in staging with <200ms P95 latency.
- UAT: three named workflows (BillingExport, ClinicalSync, LookupAPI) must pass regression scenarios in staging with sign-off from Sera QA.

Credit mechanics: procurement confirms they prefer a credit applied to the next invoice (not a cash refund). Karen — can you confirm procurement sign-off cadence?

We can hit the gating timeline if Redwood provides the final addendum by EOD tomorrow. Thanks,
Emma

(Reply quoting Monica: "I attached a marked-up SOW...")

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cho <emma@serahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, procurement@serahealth.com
Date: 2027-06-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOW sequencing & fee allocation request — final addendum for signature

Thanks everyone — we updated the addendum to reflect: the acceptance criteria Emma listed; a one-time invoice credit of $9,500 applied to the following invoice upon successful validation; and an explicit rollback clause tied to regulatory change. Monica: I incorporated your redlines and converted them into a single-page addendum referenced in Exhibit B.

Attached: SeraHealth_SOW_v2_final_addendum.pdf (ready for signature).

Next steps:
- Sera procurement (Karen / procurement@serahealth.com) to confirm signatory and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123456789
- Redwood will update the implementation plan and invoice milestone schedule on receipt of executed addendum (owner: Laura Bennett).
- Karthik to update billing schedule in HubSpot once signed.

If anyone needs the editable Word version for final tweaks, say the word — otherwise we'll route to DocuSign tonight.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: SeraHealth_SOW_v2_final_addendum.pdf)
